title: Friction: Friend and Foe
summary: Why things slow down, why rough surfaces grip, and how we increase or reduce friction.

ib.note: Coefficient of friction is treated in DP

objectives: I can explain friction as a force that opposes motion between surfaces in contact.
I can describe factors affecting friction and compare sliding and rolling friction.
I can evaluate ways to increase or reduce friction and judge whether friction is useful or harmful.
misconceptions: Friction only acts when an object is moving.
